items.title: TXT Q3 deep dive: aviation growth, defense contract milestones, and supply chain initiatives
items.summary: Aerospace and defense company Textron (NYSE:TXT) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with sales up 4.1% year on year to $3.75 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.76 per share was 21.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Textron Q3 Earnings Call Highlights
items.summary: Textron (NYSE:TXT) reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $3.8 billion, up 4% from a year earlier, while adjusted earnings per share rose to $1.76 from $1.55.
